records.text: A kobold fiercely protests when someone takes its candle, then begs for mercy or cries out in fear and flight when threatened.
A Defias thug speaks in the Brotherhood's name and threatens opponents with a freshly sharpened blade.
A kobold miner protective of its candle, warning others not to take it. The miner also cries that it will run and begs not to be killed.
A murloc forager.
Corina Steele is a weaponsmith who greets visitors and offers goods for sale.
Ruklar the Trapper is a humanoid trapper.
Thuros Lightfingers invokes the Brotherhood and speaks of its power, then anticipates using his freshly sharpened blade.
Tharynn Bouden sells trade supplies and offers customers goods to browse.
A diseased timber wolf.
Kurran Steele sells cloth and leather armor and offers repairs.
Janos Hammerknuckle is a weaponsmith who sells goods and offers repairs.
Narg is a taskmaster.
Kobold laborers guard their candles, warning others not to take them. They also cry that they will run and beg not to be killed.
A cutpurse associated with the Defias.
A Riverpaw runt that greets opponents as fresh meat and more bones to gnaw on.
Morgaine the Sly can use Gouge and Poison in combat.
Gruff Swiftbite is a rare inhabitant of Elwynn Forest.
Garrick Padfoot claims this land for the Defias Brotherhood and regards people sent from the Abbey as fresh meat, marking him as a hostile Brotherhood presence toward the Abbey.
A Defias Brotherhood bandit who threatens those opposing the Brotherhood and relishes a chance to use a freshly sharpened blade.
Brog Hamfist is a general-supplies merchant who sells goods to visitors.
Brother Danil is a general-supplies merchant who sells goods to visitors.
Dermot Johns is a cloth and leather armor merchant who sells goods and offers repairs.

Eagan Peltskinner works to contain the increasing outbreak of diseased young wolves in Northshire Valley. It pains Eagan to ask others to kill nature’s beasts, but Eagan fears an epidemic and requests diseased pelts as proof that the sick wolves have been killed.

Marshal McBride directs Northshire’s response to a growing kobold infestation. With the guards spread thin, McBride seeks outside help to reduce kobold numbers in the northern woods and investigate the larger camp near Echo Ridge Mine. McBride receives reports from scouts and dismisses helpers in a formal military tone.

Khelden Bremen is Northshire Abbey’s local mage trainer. Khelden offers mages insight into magic and warns travelers that magic can burn the untrained. A glyphic letter sealed with Khelden’s insignia directs its reader to meet the trainer inside the abbey.

Marshal Dughan struggles to keep order in Goldshire as new troubles arise. Dughan asks Guard Thomas to be consulted about rumors of murlocs at eastern Elwynn’s bridge. Thomas directs a report to Dughan about Malakai and Rolf’s deaths and the troops’ inability to contain the murlocs, hoping Dughan can find help despite scarce reinforcements.

Remy "Two Times" is a newcomer from Redridge looking for business. He offers a good price for Gold Dust and repeats himself for emphasis; he has also warned Marshal Dughan that murlocs threaten people in eastern Elwynn.
Ma Stonefield is a farmer whose vegetables are being eaten by a neighbor's prize sow. She treats the trespass as a practical farm threat and offers a reward for the sow's collar as proof.

“Auntie” Bernice Stonefield is an old widow who suspects Billy Maclure stole her necklace. She disparages Billy and asks for the necklace’s return. When sending Billy a pork belly pie, she adds the bitter message that she hopes Billy chokes on it.
Billy Maclure is at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn. Bernice Stonefield suspects Billy took her necklace and sends a pork belly pie, accompanied by a hostile message.

Gramma Stonefield tries to bring two young lovers together. Believing William Pestle may have a potion that can help, she sends William a note at the Lion’s Pride Inn in Goldshire. A young lover turns to Gramma for help reuniting with Maybell, trusting her to find a way.
Pa Maclure is a humanoid found in Elwynn Forest.
Maybell loves Tommy Joe Stonefield, but their families are bitter enemies. She longs to see him and asks a messenger to carry him her letter.
Tommy Joe Stonefield loves Maybell Maclure despite their families' bitter feud. He asks the player to speak with his grandmother, hoping she can find a way for them to be together.

William Pestle runs Pestle’s Apothecary in Stormwind with the brother Morgan. While in Goldshire, William gathers large candles for their wax and seeks help sending a shipment to Morgan in the Trade District. William welcomes promising visitors with a drink and also announces when an invisibility liquor is ready.
Gerard Tiller is a farmer who trades for refreshing spring water to ease thirsty work. He welcomes visitors back for another trade.
Kobold Workers object to others taking their candles, plead not to be killed and announce that they will run.
Joshua Maclure is a vintner who offers goods for sale.

Guard Thomas is stationed at eastern Elwynn’s bridge and provides the local assessment Marshal Dughan seeks. To complete a report, Thomas asks for a search along the river for guards Rolf and Malakai, who have not returned from investigating the area. Thomas needs to know their fate and allows for the possibility of finding their remains.

Sara Timberlain works at Eastvale Logging Camp, fashioning armor for recipients of a Stormwind Armor Marker. She also turns the red linen bandanas worn by Elwynn’s Defias into fine linen goods for those who bring her the fabric.
Murlocs found in Elwynn Forest.

Marshal Haggard is an elderly man whose eyesight is badly clouded. When he first arrived, he looked over papers in an upstairs chest but could not read them, so his knowledge of those papers is limited.

Innkeeper Farley welcomes travelers to the Lion's Pride Inn. He remembers a frightened messenger who fled into the storm after leaving letters in an upstairs chest; one was meant for Stormwind's Canal District.
Diseased young wolves found in Elwynn Forest.
Theocritus is a high mage who regards Morganth as his rival. He devised the Eye of Azora to watch Morganth from afar and has studied whether a gnoll pendant can carry communication by spell.
Goldtooth is a kobold who guards his candle. He cries out in fear when attacked and tries to flee for help when badly wounded.

Zaldimar Wefhellt trains mages and warns that magic can burn the untrained. Zaldimar directs promising pupils to Jennea Cannon at Stormwind’s wizard’s sanctum for work vital to Stormwind and Elwynn’s safety, presenting advanced lessons as an introduction to the mages’ secret war and invisible world.
Princess is the Brackwells’ prize-winning sow. She sneaks onto the Stonefields’ farm to eat their vegetables, prompting Ma Stonefield to call for her death.
Priestess Anetta is a priest trainer in Northshire. She guides young priests in the ways of the Light and directs them to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire for further instruction.

Priestess Josetta trains priests in Goldshire and warns them not to turn their backs on the Light. She tests novices seeking their first robes by asking them to heal the wounded Guard Roberts and strengthen him with Power Word: Fortitude, treating that service as proof they are worthy of the church’s support.
Jason Mathers is a fishmonger.

Katie Hunter breeds and sells horses, praising the care behind their breeding and presenting a horse as a lasting companion. When refusing a sale, Katie asks customers to earn Stormwind’s trust and says the finest steeds should not fall into its enemies’ hands.
A porcine beast in Elwynn Forest known as the Porcine Entourage.
Markus is a humanoid in Elwynn Forest.
Hogger prowls Elwynn Forest and growls about fresh meat and more bones to gnaw on.

Drusilla La Salle trains warlocks near Northshire Abbey and maintains that arcane power corrupts only the weak. Drusilla urges even those who do not follow the warlock’s path to remember that warning.
Barkeep Dobbins is a bartender and food vendor in Goldshire.
Mother Fang is a beast found in Elwynn Forest.
Fedfennel uses Demoralizing Shout and Nimble Reflexes in battle.
Morgan is known as the Collector in Elwynn Forest.
A rogue wizard of the Defias Brotherhood in Elwynn Forest. The wizard warns that the Brotherhood will not tolerate opponents’ actions and boasts of its power.
A kobold tunneler of Elwynn Forest who fiercely guards its candle, cries out about running away and begs not to be killed.
A kobold geomancer of Elwynn Forest who warns others not to take its candle, cries out about running away and begs not to be killed.
A Riverpaw outrunner of Elwynn Forest who growls about fresh meat and more bones to gnaw on.

Smith Argus is a blacksmithing trainer in Goldshire. He makes horseshoes for Verner Osgood in Lakeshire and has a business arrangement supplying him; he asks that a note accompanying the horseshoes be read.
A murloc lurker in Elwynn Forest.
A murloc streamrunner in Elwynn Forest.
Matt fishes in Elwynn Forest and grumbles when nothing bites. He considers trying Crystal Lake or returning to his old fishing hole.
Mark is a humanoid.
Joshua is a humanoid.
Bo is a humanoid.
Solomon is a humanoid.
Kevin is a humanoid.
Kyle is a humanoid.
Eric is a humanoid.
Jay is a humanoid.
Dana is a humanoid.
Cameron is a humanoid in Elwynn Forest.
John is a humanoid.
Lisa is a humanoid.
Aaron, a humanoid in Elwynn Forest.
Jose, a humanoid in Elwynn Forest.

Deputy Willem serves Northshire while many Stormwind guards fight elsewhere. He offers bounties but would rather patrol and look after Stormwind’s people. He suspects the new Defias thieves are dangerous while admitting he does not know their plans, and warns bounty hunters that Garrick Padfoot has gathered a gang around him.

Antonio Perelli is a traveling salesman who calls for shoppers near Goldshire and Sentinel Hill. He advertises rare, well-crafted goods and urges people to buy before he moves on, using the uncertainty of his return to encourage quick purchases.
Erlan Drudgemoor carries red linen bandanas sought by Sara Timberlain for her linen work.
Surena Caledon invokes the Brotherhood during confrontations, warning that it will not tolerate an opponent’s actions and calling on its power.
Homer Stonefield is a fruit seller in Elwynn Forest whose exchange lets visitors ask to browse goods.
Veldan Lightfoot is a leather armor merchant in Elwynn Forest whose services include selling goods and repairs.

Maximillian Crowe is a warlock trainer in Elwynn Forest. He warns that weakness invites arcane corruption and urges continued training. He sharply dismisses those he says are not embraced by the darkness.

Llane Beshere trains warriors at Northshire Abbey. He views Stormwind as the pillar of humanity, sustained by willpower and sturdy blades. He judges martial bearing sharply, mocking those he considers no warriors by suggesting they do something safe, such as read a book.

Lyria Du Lac trains warriors in Elwynn Forest, valuing willpower and a sturdy blade as the foundation of Stormwind’s strength. Lyria recommends veteran Harry Burlguard at Stormwind’s Pig and Whistle to competent but inexperienced warriors, trusting his lessons to help them survive. Those judged no warriors receive a mocking suggestion to read a book instead.

Jorik Kerridan trains rogues in the stable behind Northshire Abbey. He warns some visitors that he should watch his coin purse around them and directs those seeking other lessons to a trainer for their class.

Keryn Sylvius trains only rogues in Elwynn Forest. A sardonic mentor, Keryn calls trainees “fish” and mocks their readiness, yet takes promised work seriously. Keryn entrusts a package for Master Mathias Shaw to an adventurer and warns against keeping Renzik, Mathias’s second in command, waiting.
Brother Sammuel trains paladins at Northshire Abbey and offers a blessing wishing visitors the Light’s protection.

Brother Wilhelm is a paladin trainer who offers instruction in the ways of the Light and blesses visitors with its protection. He describes Duthorian Rall as an influential paladin and directs promising pupils to him at Stormwind’s Cathedral of Light.
Brother Paxton is a librarian and book copier. He prepares his own ink for the work, using a personal recipe intended to resist smearing and dry quickly.
Brother Neals manages Northshire's food and drink stores and enjoys tasting wine.
Sergeant De Vries, the Morale Officer, offers goods for sale.
Dawn Brightstar offers arcane goods for sale.
Morley Eberlein is a clothier in Elwynn Forest who sells goods and repairs equipment.

Deputy Rainer helps defend Elwynn Forest against gnolls and asks for painted armbands as proof of their defeat. He resents Stormwind officials sending much of the army abroad while thieves and gnolls threaten home. He directs experienced fighters to Gryan Stoutmantle’s People’s Militia in Westfall.
Eldrin is a tailoring trainer who offers tailoring training.
Rallic Finn is a bowyer who sells goods, offers ammunition, and repairs equipment.
Godric Rothgar is an armorer and shieldcrafter who sells goods and repairs equipment.
Alchemist Mallory is an alchemy trainer who offers training to visitors.
Herbalist Pomeroy is a herbalism trainer who offers instruction to visitors.
Quartermaster Hudson is an armorer and shieldcrafter who offers goods for sale.
Drake Lindgren is a general-goods and ammunition vendor who offers visitors the chance to browse his goods.
This Stormwind guard directs visitors to city services. He remembers Antonio giving a hat to his wife and says she adored it, showing personal gratitude alongside his courteous greeting and farewell.
Tomas is a cook who offers cooking training.
Adele is a leatherworking trainer who values Helene's support; she says Helene helped her while her husband was away at the front.
A Northshire guard.
Quartermaster Hicks is a weaponsmith who supplies goods to customers.
Terry Palin is a lumberjack who offers goods to visitors.
Lee Brown teaches fishing and can direct anglers who have outgrown his training toward more experienced teachers.
A humanoid servant of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
An Eastvale lumberjack.
Andrew Krighton is an armorer and shieldcrafter who offers goods and repairs.
Michelle Belle is a physician who offers profession training.
Toddrick is a butcher who offers goods for sale.
Kira Songshine is a traveling baker who offers fresh bread for sale.
Randal Hunter is a riding trainer who teaches Horse Riding.
A white stallion used as a riding mount.
A Defias ambusher can appear near Clara Charles when someone approaches.
A humanoid known as Dead-Tooth Jack in Elwynn Forest.
Remen Marcot delivers Gakin the Darkbinder’s summons for further training. Remen complains about a fruitless search for the recipient and urges discretion about Gakin’s meeting place.
Henze Faulk expresses heartfelt gratitude to the player.
Helene Peltskinner trains in skinning.
Donni Anthania is a vendor known as the Crazy Cat Lady.
A humanoid named Dane Winslow.
Cylina Darkheart can cast Summon Imp.
Erma is a stable master who helps travelers stable pets and recover lost companions.
Falkhaan Isenstrider is an adventurer whose best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride Inn; he directs travelers there for rest.
Melika Isenstrider is an assistant innkeeper.
A Defias dockmaster serving the Brotherhood, he regards opponents as pests and threatens those who obstruct it.
A Defias dockworker aligned with the Brotherhood, he threatens opponents, boasts of its power, and is eager to use his sharpened blade.

Milly Osworth tends a grape harvest threatened by Defias at Northshire. She worries both that the brigands will steal the grapes and that pursuing guards will trample them, and asks for help recovering the crop.
Selina Dourman welcomes visitors to the Darkmoon Faire as an information guide, offering help with questions about purchases, prize tickets, Darkmoon Cards, and attractions.
Supervisor Raelen coordinates the logging crew and presses them to meet their wood quota and fill the wagon before the day's deadline.
Kitta Firewind is an enchanting trainer.
A Northshire peasant.
A peasant in Eastvale.
Merissa Stilwell is a named quest giver associated with a Collector's Edition welcome voucher.
Kim Bridenbecker is a humanoid in Elwynn Forest.
Rob Bridenbecker is a humanoid in Elwynn Forest.
Ashley Bridenbecker is a humanoid in Elwynn Forest.
Guard Roberts thanks priests who heal him, hopes the Light will help him face murlocs, and wishes them the Light’s protection.
James Clark is a humanoid in Elwynn Forest.
A Rogue Black Drake that uses Flame Breath in combat.
An expeditionary mountaineer.
An expeditionary priest.
A swift palomino horse.
A swift white horse.
A swift brown horse.
Sayge is a fortune-teller who reflects on how choices shape a person's identity and fortune.
Silas welcomes visitors as an enthusiastic promoter of the Darkmoon Faire, directing them to its attractions, vendors and refreshments.
Burth speaks brusquely, warns visitors against interfering with Silas Darkmoon, and claims to have lived in Dire Maul.
Gelvas Grimegate handles Darkmoon Faire ticket redemption, exchanging tickets for prizes.
Yebb Neblegear welcomes visitors to the Darkmoon Zoo Bizarre, a trove of living legends and mythical oddities. He warns that its artifacts and beasts can harm curious visitors.
Kerri Hicks presents herself as the strongest woman alive, warning that her handshake could break another person's hand.
Chronos calls himself He Who Never Forgets and presents his memory as flawless, down to minor details.
Rinling's greeting says his booth needs repairs and that an oath binds him to cheer visitors.
Sylannia is a Darkmoon Faire drink vendor. Her greeting promotes the Faire's brews and welcomes tips.
Stamp Thunderhorn is a Darkmoon Faire food vendor who calls visitors to his grilled food stall.
Lhara is a Darkmoon Faire exotic-goods vendor who presents her wares as personally sourced and authentic.
Professor Thaddeus Paleo welcomes visitors to the Darkmoon Faire and offers cards and exotic goods. He is especially interested in hearing from visitors who collect sets of lesser Darkmoon cards.
A Darkmoon Faire carnie encourages visitors to enjoy the Faire, buy refreshments and souvenirs, and keep the grounds clean.
Flik is a small vendor whose patter offers frogs and leather balls and calls after a runaway frog.
A ram from Khaz Modan.
Felinni is a beast found in Mulgore and Terokkar Forest.
Hornsley is a beast found in Elwynn Forest, Mulgore, and Terokkar Forest.
A pygmy cockatrice, a beast found in Elwynn Forest, Mulgore, and Terokkar Forest.

Morja is fond of the pet frog Jubjub, who loves Dark Iron Ale. Keeping enough ale is a worry: Morja fears Jubjub will wander off to find more, calls anxiously when she disappears, and warmly welcomes her return.

Maxima Blastenheimer, the Darkmoon Faire Cannoneer, welcomes visitors enthusiastically, proudly presents the Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon, and offers to explain its use while teasing a guest about fitting inside.
Elder Stormbrow speaks of the new year as the time when the ancients awake.
A Skeletal Soldier that uses Scourge Strike in combat.
Bradford Bridenbecker is a humanoid in Elwynn Forest.
This warden welcomes visitors who come to honor the flame, encourages honoring Alliance festival fires, and urges desecrating Horde fires.
A cheerful human spirit reunited with friends and family, celebrating with stories and food. The spirit speaks warmly of Chapman and asks for more Bread of the Dead.
Gregory Tabor is a Pilgrim's Bounty guide for learning traditional holiday cooking; the festival's guidance directs interested cooks to him.
Wilmina Holbeck is a Pilgrim's Bounty vendor whose goods visitors can browse.
Ellen Moore trains cooks and welcomes new students, especially around Pilgrim’s Bounty. She is Jasper Moore’s wife.
Jasper Moore helps with traditional Pilgrim’s Bounty cooking. He is Ellen Moore’s husband and directs visitors seeking feast traditions to the hostesses.
A ghostly human celebrant welcomes friends and family back to celebrate and share stories of old.
Crown Lackeys operate near Orgrimmar and Westbrook Garrison. Snap Snagglebolt and Snip Snagglebolt target them in investigations of the Crown’s chemical wagons.
A sentry for Crown Chemical Co., this guard keeps supply deliveries moving and urges couriers to hurry crates bound for the Lovely Merchant.

place_records.text: You are in Elwynn Forest, Alliance land in the Eastern Kingdoms. Northshire Valley, Goldshire, the Eastvale Logging Camp and the Tower of Azora are Alliance settlements. Murlocs gather on the rivers and lakes to the east, Defias thieves are a threat across the land, and kobolds have been spreading through the northern woods.

You are in Northshire Valley, a farming valley in Elwynn Forest. Deputy Willem keeps the peace while many Stormwind guards are away, and Marshal McBride is fighting a growing kobold infestation in the northern woods. Diseased wolves roam the valley, Defias brigands threaten Milly Osworth's grape harvest, and a priestess teaches priests here while a weaponsmith sells arms.

You are in Crystal Lake, a fishing spot in Elwynn Forest. Lee Brown teaches fishing here and sends the more experienced anglers on to other teachers, while Jason Mathers sells fish. Murlocs and mangy wolves share the shore with a few Defias bandits.

You are in Echo Ridge Mine, a mine in Elwynn Forest worked by kobolds. Kobold workers guard their candles and beg not to be killed, and diseased timber wolves roam nearby. Marshal McBride wants the larger kobold camp near the mine investigated.
You are in Jasperlode Mine, a mine in Elwynn Forest. Kobold miners and geomancers hold its tunnels, and Ruklar the Trapper lurks here too.
You are in Heroes' Vigil, a spot in Elwynn Forest. Defias rogue wizards have infiltrated the area and were seen going over papers, and Gazin Tenorm in Stormwind wants to know what those Defias plan.
You are in Fargodeep Mine, a mine in Elwynn Forest. Kobolds infest Fargodeep Mine, with kobold tunnelers and miners digging its passages, and a young forest bear sometimes wanders in.

You are in Northshire Vineyards, the grape land east of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. Garrick Padfoot claims this land for the Defias Brotherhood, and Defias thugs threaten anyone who opposes them with freshly sharpened blades.
You are in Forest's Edge, a place at the edge of Elwynn Forest. A Stormwind guard directs visitors to the city's services. Riverpaw outrunners and runts roam the area, and Hogger lurks nearby.

You are in Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, a farm in Elwynn Forest. The Brackwells' prize-winning sow, Princess, sneaks onto the Stonefield Farm to eat vegetables. Defias bandits and murloc foragers also roam here.

You are in the Stonefield Farm, a family farm in Elwynn Forest. Ma Stonefield's vegetables are being raided by the Brackwells' prize sow, and the family is locked in a bitter feud with the Maclures. Riverpaw runts prowl the fields, and Homer Stonefield sells fruit here.

You are in the Maclure Vineyards, a vineyard in Elwynn Forest. Joshua Maclure is the vintner here and sells his wares, and Gerard Tiller trades refreshing spring water to thirsty workers. Billy Maclure is accused of stealing an old widow's necklace, and the Maclures are bitter enemies of the Stonefields.
You are in Stone Cairn Lake, a lake in Elwynn Forest where murlocs have built a village. Murloc foragers and lurkers roam its shores, along with riverpaw outrunners and Defias rogue wizards.

You are in Goldshire, a village in Elwynn Forest. Its inn, smithy and trainers serve Alliance travelers. Marshal Dughan keeps order here, but he is not convinced by reports of murlocs at the eastern bridge, which a newcomer named Remy Two Times has warned him about. Mangy wolves roam nearby.

You are in Eastvale Logging Camp, an Alliance lumber camp in Elwynn Forest. Loggers cut wood here under Supervisor Raelen, who presses them to fill the wagon before each day's deadline. Wolves and bears north of the camp have chased the workers away from wood they already chopped. Sara Timberlain turns the red linen bandanas of Elwynn's Defias into fine goods.

You are in the Tower of Azora, a tower in Elwynn Forest where Alliance mages work. The high mage Theocritus watches his rival Morganth through the Eye of Azora from afar. Morganth is a vicious mage who lives in the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge. Gray Forest Wolves and bears roam the woods around the tower.
You are in Mirror Lake, a lake in Elwynn Forest. Defias bandits and a Defias rogue wizard prowl its shores, and mangy wolves and forest spiders roam nearby.

You are in Westbrook Garrison, an Alliance post in Elwynn Forest. Deputy Rainer helps defend the forest against gnolls, and he resents Stormwind officials for sending much of the army abroad while thieves and gnolls threaten home. Hogger, a huge gnoll, prowls the woods of southwestern Elwynn. Its armorers and weaponsmiths sell and repair gear.
You are in Jerod's Landing, a waterside spot in Elwynn Forest. Defias bandits, Defias dockworkers and a Defias dockmaster haunt the shore, and Thuros Lightfingers prowls among them.

You are in Ridgepoint Tower, an Alliance post in Elwynn Forest. A Stormwind guard greets visitors here, and he remembers Antonio giving his wife a hat she adored. Prowlers and young bears roam the ground around the tower, and a Defias bandit lurks there too.
